newsitem.title: UK: FOCUS-Ramco to buy JKX, pledges turnaround.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS-Ramco to buy JKX, pledges turnaround.

text.p: Oil exploration firm Ramco Energy Plc on Wednesday launched a 54 million pound ($90.7 million) agreed bid for JKXOil & Gas and promptly pledged to turn around JKX's ill-fated operations in the Ukraine.
Shares in JKX firmed 3-1/2 pence on the take-over news to trade at 47-1/2 pence in late morning business. Ramco gained 30 pence to 10 pounds and 57-1/2 pence.
Aberdeen-based Ramco is offering one new Ramco share for every 25 JKX shares, valuing each JKX share at 46.3 pence.
Ramco, which is mainly active in Azerbaijan, promised a major shake-up at JKX which saw its share value collapse in the past year.
It said its bid offered the best chance for JKX shareholders to recoup losses on their investments after JKX shares slumped 68 percent in the past 12 months.
"The case I bring directly to shareholders is that they have the best chance to redress and make up for their past losses by coming on board with us," Ramco Chief Executive Steve Remp told Reuters.
Several institutional investors, who have a combined 26 percent interest in JKX, have already accepted the offer.
JKX is a small exploration company mainly active in Ukraine through its 49 percent interest in the Poltava Petroleum Company (PPC).
JKX fell on hard times last year when PPC lost an important customer, who was no longer allowed to operate in the Ukrainian gas market.
Additionally, PPC has found it hard to find clients who have the money to pay their bills.
But Ramco believes the situation in Ukraine is going to improve for domestic producers such as PPC as the country can no longer afford to mostly rely on foreign supply.
By trying to link-up JKX with a large Western energy company, Ramco wants take advantage of any opportunities arising in Ukraine.
Preliminary negotiations with a potential partner have already taken place, Ramco said.
The company, which has been widely praised for its pioneering role to bring together Western companies to boost the Azeri offshore oil industry, wants to double JKX's Ukrainian gas operations.
It also seeks to strengthen activities in Georgia where both JKX and Ramco are already active. ($ = 0.595 British Pounds)
